name: DRSongsLyrics
description: This dataset contains 358 lyrics of songs for the rock bands 'The Rolling Stones' and 'Deep Purple'. The bands are equally represented in the dataset (179 songs for each band). This dataset was extracted from the much larger 'SongLyrics' dataset created by Sergey Kuznetsov.
creator: Fernando Duarte
contributor: Sergey Kuznetsov was the original author of the full dataset
